items.title: Filmfare Award for Chal Re Mana Jaau
items.summary: Nihira won Best Playback Singer (Female) at the Filmfare Awards Marathi 2026 for “Chal Re Mana Jaau” from the film Ata Thambaycha Naay!.
items.body:
The song, composed by Gulraj Singh with lyrics by Manoj Yadav, marked Nihira's return to film playback singing. Ata Thambaycha Naay! was the evening's biggest winner, including Best Film.

The awards night premiered on Sony Marathi on 6 September 2026.

items.title: Ishq Manayein Kya? as a duet with Shaan
items.summary: A new duet version of Ishq Manayein Kya? with Shaan is out on YouTube.
items.body: In the weeks around the release, short videos on Nihira's channel show Shaan talking about the song and the recording session.
items._note: From the channel feed: duet published 2026-10-09; related videos 2026-10-06, 2026-10-14, 2026-10-27.

items.title: Trishna honoured at the Clef Music Awards 2023
items.summary: At the third edition of the Clef Music Awards, Nihira's EP Trishna won in two categories: Best Artist (Hindustani Classical) and Album of the Year.

items.title: Music Unplugged features the Trishna EP
items.summary: Music Unplugged reported on Trishna, Nihira's first EP, released in December 2022: four songs about Radha's longing and love for Krishna, composed and sung by Nihira.

items.title: Rolling Stone India picks Trishna
items.summary: Rolling Stone India included the Trishna EP in its round-up of new releases to tune in to.

items.title: Ishq Manayein Kya? returns as a swing version
items.summary: Three years after the salsa original, Nihira re-recorded Ishq Manayein Kya? with new rock-and-roll and swing arrangements by Tanmay Pawar, keeping Manoj Yadav's lyrics.

items.title: Tumi: Nihira's first Bengali single
items.summary: In an interview with Planet Bollywood, Nihira talks about composing Tumi, her first song in Bengali, written by Santanu Ghatak and produced by Ashwin Srinivasan.

items.title: Monsoon single Toote Chhaate released
items.summary: Music Unplugged reported on Toote Chhaate, a rain-and-romance song composed and sung by Nihira, written by Alok Ranjan Srivastava and arranged by Rhythm Shaw, with an illustrated video by Barun Roy.

items.title: A Hindi song with Cuban salsa
items.summary: Asian Lite featured Ishq Manayein Kya?, Nihira's Hindi salsa recorded with the Cuban band Orquesta Son Diamantes and produced in Barcelona.

items.title: Back to playback singing with Chal Re Mana Jaau
items.summary: Planet Bollywood interviewed Nihira about Chal Re Mana Jaau from the Marathi film Ata Thambaycha Naay!, composed and co-sung by Gulraj Singh with lyrics by Manoj Yadav: her return to film playback after years of independent releases.

items.title: Aaye Abhi Toh: a ghazal with Sheeba Lateef and Prem Murti
items.summary: Planet Bollywood spoke with Nihira about Aaye Abhi Toh, a ghazal written by Sheeba Lateef and composed by Prem Murti, in which she sings the final verse, and about her lifelong love of ghazals.

items.title: Jag Jaage: a single with Chirag Todi
items.summary: In a Planet Bollywood interview, Nihira describes Jag Jaage, her first collaboration with guitarist Chirag Todi: a jazz-tinged song she composed around Raag Bhimpalasi, with lyrics by Sreenath Sreenivasan and production by Jonathan Edward.
